questions.question: When God spoke the Ten Commandments to Israel, what did He say He had done for them?
What was the first command God gave Israel when He spoke the Ten Commandments?

answers.text: Have no other gods before Him
Build Him an altar on the mountain
Bring Him an offering each morning

questions.question: In the Ten Commandments, what reason did God give Israel for keeping the Sabbath day holy?

answers.text: He made everything in six days and rested on the seventh
Israel rested for seven days after leaving Egypt
Moses waited seven days at the foot of the mountain

questions.question: After the people saw the thunder, lightning and smoke on the mountain, what did they ask Moses to do?

answers.text: Speak to them instead of God
Lead them away from the mountain
